Title: Filtering on child field using substring
Description: Hello,

When I execute the following SQL which filters documents on a parent field, the query seems to get the correct result.

select $ from Patients WHERE substring($.nameFirst,0,1) ALL = 'd'

However, when I use the following SQL on a child field using substring I do not get any result.
 
select $ from Patients WHERE substring($.Tumors[*].dateOfDiagnosis,0,4) ALL = '2018'

What am I doing wrong?
